Working Relationship  
Xin and I share overlapping responsibilities in AdVerve’s mobile stack, often pairing on complex issues or code reviews. As a small team, our daily interactions are dense—debugging crashes, refining UI workflows, or aligning on cross-platform strategies. His deep familiarity with Kotlin and Swift lets us iterate quickly, and his knack for distilling technical debt into actionable steps keeps our codebase lean.  

Day-to-Day Observations  
Xin’s routine is a blend of hands-on development and mentorship. He’s the one troubleshooting silent app crashes during nightly builds, tweaking CI/CD pipelines to cut deployment time by 15%, and mentoring junior devs on Swift memory management. His test automation scripts, written in TypeScript, slashed regression bugs by 30% last quarter. Even during tight deadlines, he’ll refactor legacy code to align with modern practices, which is rare in a small team.  

Standout Moments  
Last summer, Xin spearheaded a rewrite of AdVerve’s push notification system using Flutter, which improved reliability by 40% and reduced server costs. He also led a sprint to integrate a third-party analytics tool, handling both Swift and Kotlin codebases seamlessly. His attention to edge cases—like handling iOS 16’s new privacy features—prevented major rollout issues.  

Recommendation  
Xin is a pragmatic problem-solver who thrives in fast-paced, resource-constrained environments. His technical depth in Kotlin and Swift, paired with a commitment to clean architecture, makes him a reliable asset. Beyond skills, his collaborative spirit and ability to prioritize without losing detail set him apart. A team with Xin is always ahead of the curve.
